assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from publisher_live at creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt. Integrity holds for [5884,6024) and its whole-file digest matches publisher_pin. Relevance comes from section 4(a)'s express reference to “trademark or patent rights held by Affirmer.” Interpretation follows from the exclusion of waiver, surrender, licensing, and other effects “by this document.” Applicability follows from the Statement of Purpose identifying the person applying CC0 to the Work and 4(a) identifying the rights holder. The contradiction check against sections 1(iv), 2, 3, and 4(c) found neither a waiver nor a fallback license of the specified rights, nor any clearance of others' rights.

limitations: The finding concerns the effect of this instrument on the Affirmer's own rights. Separate grants, defenses, ownership, and clearance of other persons' rights require separate evidence.
reasoning: When the Affirmer applies CC0 to a Work, section 4(a) expressly preserves trademark and patent rights held by that Affirmer. Its verbs cover both surrender under the waiver and licensing under the fallback.
